description: Structured EUR-Lex search: keywords plus filters (dates, type, author, procedure, collection) → CELEX numbers, titles, dates; read a hit with lex_get_document. Matching is literal: use 1–3 distinctive terms; for concept questions use lex_semantic_legislation / lex_semantic_case_law. Cost: 3 credits per result page (~10 results; unfetched pages refunded).

author.description: Issuing institution(s). One or a list of: commission, council, parliament, court-of-justice, general-court, civil-service-tribunal, ecb, eca, eesc, cor, ema, efsa.

documentType.description: Document type(s). Several types fan out into one EUR-Lex query each. One or a list of: judgment, opinion, order, regulation, directive, decision, recommendation, communication, proposal, report, resolution, declaration, treaty, protocol, agreement, written-question, oral-question, consolidated-text, guideline, implementing, staff-working-document.

maxPages.description: Result pages to fetch (3 credits each; clamped to the plan: FREE 1, STARTER 5, PROFESSIONAL 20, higher 100). Raise it when a tight date filter reports postFilteredBy "date".

procedure.description: Legislative procedure(s). One or a list of: ordinary, codecision, consent, consultation, budget, implementing, delegated, comitology, appointment, non-legislative.

query.description: Search text. Quotes force an exact phrase. "*" = no text constraint (filter-only search).

subdomain.description: Sub-collection(s), e.g. "case-law", "legislation", "consolidated". One or a list of: LEGISLATION, CONSLEG, TREATIES, EU_CASE_LAW, LEGAL_PROCEDURE, INTER_AGREE, PRE_ACTS, PAR_QUESTION, NAT_CASE_LAW, legislation, consolidated, treaties, case-law, legal-procedure, international, preparatory, questions, national-case-law.

textScope.description: Where the text must match (API default title-text).

name: lex_search
title: Search EUR-Lex
